hebrewText: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה קְצִינֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם הַאֲזִ֛ינוּ תּוֹרַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ עַ֥ם עֲמֹרָֽה

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: a magistrate (as deciding) or other leader
tokens.kjv: captain, guide, prince, ruler. Compare H6278 (עֵת קָצִין).

tokens.bdb: Sedom, a place near the Dead Sea
to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen
tokens.kjv: give (perceive by the) ear, hear(-ken). See H239 (אָזַן).
